show_work.definition: Gross revenue minus the value of cancelled (returned) lines.
show_work.caveats: Returns are booked in the week of the cancellation invoice, not the week of the original sale.

show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07'

summary.text: During the week of 2011-10-31, net revenue reached £288,344, marking a strong week-over-week increase of +23.1% compared to £234,203 the previous week. This performance also exceeded the prior 4-week average of £249,454 by +15.6%. Growth was supported by 527 orders, representing a +1.5% change from 519 orders last week and a +10.9% rise against the 4-week average of 475. Average order value climbed to £555.50, up +18.8% week-over-week and +1.4% versus the 4-week average of £547.85. The primary category driver was Kitchen and Dining, while the United Kingdom led as the top country driver, and returning customers were the leading customer type driver.
